4. Cosmic foundations: the star system

Built Solar System Module – Specification §2–8, §13; Additions §2–3.

WT asks forDemiurge gives
Star class, mass, luminosity, agemass (preset, typed, or drawn from an initial mass function), class O–M with subclasses, radius, temperature, lifetime, brightening with age
Effects on radiationX-ray and UV history, flares, magnetic shielding
Planetsarchitecture presets, spacing in mutual Hill radii, masses against the frost line, radius from composition, eccentricity, inclination, class
The habitable planethabitable zone √(L/1.1)–√(L/0.53); Earth-like as physics decides, guaranteed, excluded, or at a chosen probability
Gas giants' influencewide gaps, a longer bombardment, the asteroid belt
Moons and tidesregular, giant-impact and captured moons; tides; eclipses; tidal heating; tilt held by a large moon
Day, year, tilt, eccentricityrotation, locking, solar day, tilt by what holds it, longitude of perihelion, seasons by latitude
Minor objects (BWM)belts, dwarf planets, a comet-cloud flag
The cloudmetallicity and the elements that control giants, water, density, heat and the elements of life
Moons in culture and myth (WT)built: the sky as a people sees it (sun, moons, eclipses, seasons, comets, omens), a role and eclipse myth for each moon in each religion (section 12; Lore §4–5)

Still to build Binary stars, rings, resonances inside the systems (in part)

The arithmetic is built (Additions §3): a star’s companion (mass, period, separation, eccentricity), the stable orbits round one star or both (Holman and Wiegert), a second sun in the sky; rings of giants; resonances and hints of migration. None is yet inside the systems makeSystem makes, because planet generation does not know about a second star. Evolution beyond the main sequence is not modelled.
